event.description: Test rank8 positions with zero weight decay
event.proposal: family: position representation; current retained incumbent is 2933 parameters at 100.0000%, a +1.00 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: none; same-family failed result: attempt-0048, rank9 factorized positions at 2933/97.30% with standard weight decay (and the older rank8 factor at 4136/0.11%); prior attempts in this family: 7. The training-control follow-up attempt-0049 showed that rank9 reaches 100% when weight decay is removed. Hypothesis: under that improved optimizer condition, the nearest rank8 positional basis may now retain enough capacity, saving another 49 parameters to 2884. This is more informative than testing a more aggressive rank7 because it separates the rank boundary from the previously identified regularization effect; the nearest untested alternative is rank7, which would skip the first post-control compression step. Keep d14/h2/L2, MQA, independent head-local maps, ff23, affine-free block pre-norms, final learned scale without bias, reversed operands, mixed-digit curriculum, zero weight decay, and 30000 steps; retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 2933 parameters.
